# Command reference

Every `datarepo` command, with every argument it takes. This page is generated from the program's own argument parser, so it lists exactly what the installed version accepts; `datarepo <command> --help` prints the same text.

New here? Start with [getting-started.md](getting-started.md), which runs the main commands end to end on the example instance shipped in this repository.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`doctor`](#datarepo-doctor) | check this machine can ingest |
| [`manifest`](#datarepo-manifest) | show what the producing instance offers |
| [`ingest`](#datarepo-ingest) | build a Parquet bundle for one or more datasets |
| [`inspect`](#datarepo-inspect) | summarise a written bundle |
| [`study`](#datarepo-study) | write a study layer's delivered rows as a study bundle |
| [`run`](#datarepo-run) | run a released engine on stored data (the instance operator's step) |
| [`publish`](#datarepo-publish) | build the catalog from every ingested dataset, then write the static site |
| [`build`](#datarepo-build) | load bundles into one DuckDB catalog |
| [`site`](#datarepo-site) | write the public static site for one catalog |
| [`catalog`](#datarepo-catalog) | summarise a built catalog |
| [`query`](#datarepo-query) | run one read-only SQL query against a catalog |
| [`mcp`](#datarepo-mcp) | serve one catalog to an agent over stdio (MCP) |

`datarepo --version` prints the installed version.

**Exit status.** `0` when the command did what it was asked, including a no-op it reports (an unchanged catalog, a delivery already written). `1` when it refused: a dataset the manifest excludes, a check that failed, a file that does not match its record. The reason is on standard error. `2` for a command line it cannot parse.

## Check the machine

Run first on a new machine.

### `datarepo doctor`

Check this machine can ingest.

```
datarepo doctor [-h]
```


## Ingest: a producer's run becomes a bundle

An instance operator runs these once per dataset, after the search. See [ingest.md](ingest.md) and [study.md](study.md).

### `datarepo manifest`

Show what the producing instance offers.

```
datarepo manifest [-h] manifest
```

| Argument | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `manifest` | yes |  |

### `datarepo ingest`

Build a Parquet bundle for one or more datasets.

```
datarepo ingest [-h] [--store STORE] [--mm-settings MM_SETTINGS] [--overwrite] [-v] manifest [accession ...]
```

| Argument | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `manifest` | yes | the producing instance's manifest.yaml |
| `accession` (zero or more) |  | datasets to ingest; default is every 'include' |
| `--store` `STORE` |  | where to write bundles; default is the manifest's store |
| `--mm-settings` `MM_SETTINGS` |  | MetaMorpheus install to read modification definitions from |
| `--overwrite` |  | rebuild a bundle that already exists |
| `-v`, `--verbose` |  | show every reconciliation check |

### `datarepo inspect`

Summarise a written bundle.

```
datarepo inspect [-h] [--json] bundle
```

| Argument | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `bundle` | yes | bundle directory or its bundle.json |
| `--json` |  | print the manifest verbatim |

### `datarepo study`

Write a study layer's delivered rows as a study bundle.

```
datarepo study [-h] [--store STORE] [--overwrite] manifest
```

| Argument | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `manifest` | yes | the study delivery's study.yaml |
| `--store` `STORE` |  | where to write the bundle; default is the manifest's store |
| `--overwrite` |  | rewrite a delivery already written |

### `datarepo run`

Run a released engine on stored data (the instance operator's step).

```
datarepo run [-h] --store STORE [--input ROLE=PATH] [--bundle PXD=ID] [--latest] {logs.resolve_genes} accession [accession ...]
```

| Argument | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `engine` | yes | the engine to run One of: `logs.resolve_genes`. |
| `accession` (one or more) | yes | datasets whose searched databases to run on |
| `--store` `STORE` | yes | the instance's bundle store |
| `--input` `ROLE=PATH` (repeatable) |  | an input file by role; repeatable |
| `--bundle` `PXD=ID` (repeatable) |  | pin a dataset to one bundle id |
| `--latest` |  | take each dataset's newest bundle |

## Build and publish: bundles become a catalog and a site

`publish` is `build` then `site` in one step. See [build.md](build.md), [site.md](site.md) and [operating.md](operating.md).

### `datarepo publish`

Build the catalog from every ingested dataset, then write the static site.

```
datarepo publish [-h] --site SITE [--store STORE] [--out OUT] [--study-latest LAYER] [--title TITLE] [--base-url BASE_URL] [--data-url DATA_URL] [--notice NOTICE] [--about ABOUT] [--purpose TEXT] [--keyword WORD] manifest [accession ...]
```

| Argument | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `manifest` | yes | the producing instance's manifest.yaml |
| `accession` (zero or more) |  | datasets to load; default is every 'include' that has a bundle, naming those without |
| `--site` `SITE` | yes | the site directory: empty, or a site written before |
| `--store` `STORE` |  | where bundles live; default is the manifest's store |
| `--out` `OUT` |  | catalog file to write; default is &lt;store&gt;/../catalog.duckdb |
| `--study-latest` `LAYER` (repeatable) |  | load a study layer's newest delivery; repeatable. None is loaded unless named |
| `--title` `TITLE` |  | the site's name; default from the catalog's instance |
| `--base-url` `BASE_URL` |  | where the site will be served, for absolute links and the sitemap |
| `--data-url` `DATA_URL` |  | where the bundle store is served; enables downloads and croissant.json |
| `--notice` `NOTICE` |  | a banner for the top of every page and of llms.txt |
| `--about` `ABOUT` |  | a Markdown file: the front page's overview of the project |
| `--purpose` `TEXT` |  | the question this instance serves, ending "for questions about ..."; e.g. "how organelle proteomes change with age". Without it no page claims one |
| `--keyword` `WORD` (repeatable) |  | a schema.org keyword for every dataset page, e.g. aging; repeatable |

### `datarepo build`

Load bundles into one DuckDB catalog.

```
datarepo build [-h] [--store STORE] [--out OUT] [--bundle PXD=ID] [--latest] [--study LAYER=ID] [--study-latest LAYER] [--release RELEASE] [--overwrite] [-v] manifest [accession ...]
```

| Argument | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `manifest` | yes | the producing instance's manifest.yaml |
| `accession` (zero or more) |  | datasets to load; default is every 'include' |
| `--store` `STORE` |  | where bundles live; default is the manifest's store |
| `--out` `OUT` |  | catalog file to write; default is &lt;store&gt;/../catalog.duckdb |
| `--bundle` `PXD=ID` (repeatable) |  | pin a dataset to one bundle id; repeatable |
| `--latest` |  | when a dataset has several bundles, take the newest instead of refusing |
| `--study` `LAYER=ID` (repeatable) |  | load a study layer's delivery, pinned to one bundle id; repeatable |
| `--study-latest` `LAYER` (repeatable) |  | load a study layer's newest delivery; repeatable, refused with --release |
| `--release` `RELEASE` |  | release version this catalog is for; requires every dataset pinned with --bundle |
| `--overwrite` |  | rebuild a catalog that is current |
| `-v`, `--verbose` |  | list every check that ran |

### `datarepo site`

Write the public static site for one catalog.

```
datarepo site [-h] --out OUT [--title TITLE] [--base-url BASE_URL] [--data-url DATA_URL] [--notice NOTICE] [--about ABOUT] [--purpose TEXT] [--keyword WORD] catalog
```

| Argument | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `catalog` | yes | the catalog .duckdb file |
| `--out` `OUT` | yes | an empty directory, or a site written before |
| `--title` `TITLE` |  | the site's name; default from the catalog's instance |
| `--base-url` `BASE_URL` |  | where the site will be served, for absolute links and the sitemap |
| `--data-url` `DATA_URL` |  | where the bundle store is served; enables downloads and croissant.json |
| `--notice` `NOTICE` |  | a banner for the top of every page and of llms.txt |
| `--about` `ABOUT` |  | a Markdown file: the front page's overview of the project |
| `--purpose` `TEXT` |  | the question this instance serves, ending "for questions about ..."; e.g. "how organelle proteomes change with age". Without it no page claims one |
| `--keyword` `WORD` (repeatable) |  | a schema.org keyword for every dataset page, e.g. aging; repeatable |

### `datarepo catalog`

Summarise a built catalog.

```
datarepo catalog [-h] [--json] catalog
```

| Argument | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `catalog` | yes | the catalog .duckdb file |
| `--json` |  | print the catalog's own tables verbatim |

## Ask: read a catalog

See [querying.md](querying.md) and [mcp.md](mcp.md).

### `datarepo query`

Run one read-only SQL query against a catalog.

```
datarepo query [-h] [--format {table,tsv,json}] [--limit LIMIT] catalog sql
```

| Argument | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `catalog` | yes | the catalog .duckdb file |
| `sql` | yes | the statement to run |
| `--format` `FORMAT` |  | One of: `table`, `tsv`, `json`. |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` |  | row cap; 0 for no cap |

### `datarepo mcp`

Serve one catalog to an agent over stdio (MCP).

```
datarepo mcp [-h] [--catalog CATALOG] [--install] [--list] [--check] [--name NAME] [--config CONFIG] [--force]
```

| Argument | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--catalog` `CATALOG` |  | the catalog .duckdb file to serve; never auto-discovered |
| `--install` |  | register it with Claude Code and exit |
| `--list` |  | show the datarepo servers already registered |
| `--check` |  | open the catalog and report, without serving |
| `--name` `NAME` |  | server name, for registering several catalogs |
| `--config` `CONFIG` |  | MCP config to write; default is the Claude Code user config |
| `--force` |  | repoint an entry of that name at this catalog |
